name: button
summary: Primary action control. Triggers an operation or navigation.

variant.note: These render distinctly. See knownIssues for variants that fall back to navy.

shadow.note: INVERTED (F6): shadow=true applies .button-shadow which sets box-shadow:none

shape.note: icon-button (218x); renders 4px radius not circular due to default rounded (F7)

shape=circle.note: Ant circular icon button; needs aria-label

class=squared-button.note: buttons.less square icon button — most common icon form; needs aria-label

do: Use variant=primary for the single main action on a view.
Use danger/error for destructive actions, paired with a confirm.
Use neutral-* variants for secondary/tertiary actions.
Show :loading during async work to prevent double-submits.
dont: More than one primary button in the same action group.
Hardcoding colors — variants already map to design tokens.
Using a button for what is really a link (use FlotoLink).
whenToUse: Any user-triggered action (submit, create, delete, apply).
decisionFlow: Single most-important action on the view/dialog? -> variant=primary (primary-alt for confirm inside a modal).
Cancel/Reset/secondary next to the primary? -> variant=default.
Inline text-like action (Add/Create New/Clear All)? -> variant=transparent.
Icon-only / space-tight? -> icon button (class=squared-button, or shape=circle).
Modifiers: block=full width; outline=ghost/bordered; size=small for dense. Avoid neutral/info (navy, F1).

primary.useWhen: the ONE most-important action on a view/form/wizard
primary.dontUse: if a primary already exists, or action is destructive/navigation

primary-alt.useWhen: the confirm/save inside a modal where full navy is too heavy
primary-alt.dontUse: for the page-level main action (use primary)

default.useWhen: the secondary next to a primary: Cancel/Reset/Clear/Back
default.dontUse: for the main action or destructive action
default.example: Cancel beside Save; Reset on a filter

neutral-lightest.dontUse: for the main or inline-text action
neutral-lightest.example: Filter bar, Hide all, granularity toggles

neutral-lighter.useWhen: subtle add/secondary slightly stronger than transparent (rare)

transparent.useWhen: inline text-like actions: Create New/+Add/Clear All/in-content
transparent.dontUse: for navigation (use FlotoLink) or when more prominence is needed
transparent.example: Create New, Add Credential, Clear All

success.useWhen: explicit approve/accept in a review flow (rare)

outline.useWhen: secondary needing a clear edge, e.g. on busy/colored/image backgrounds
outline.dontUse: when default/transparent reads clearly on a plain surface
outline.example: bordered action on a colored panel

squared-button.useWhen: recognizable repeated space-tight icon action (row edit/delete, toolbar, modal close); 35x35
squared-button.dontUse: when the icon meaning isn't obvious

shape=circle.must: aria-label; add :rounded=false for a true circle (F7)

block.useWhen: button should fill its container: drawers, mobile, single-action forms, login
block.dontUse: in a row with other buttons

link(FlotoLink).dontUse: for actions that change data/state (use a button)

danger.useWhen: Avoid in new work — it is a rare (3×) light/ghost style, NOT solid red (finding F2). For anything destructive prefer error + a confirm.
danger.dontUse: For real destructive actions (use error) or for a normal save (use primary); the ghost rendering under-signals danger.
danger.example: Legacy light ghost-danger action; migrate to error for delete/remove flows.

icon-circle.useWhen: An icon-only action where a circular/standalone/floating affordance is wanted — overlay and floating controls (topology/chart overlays). Must provide an aria-label.
icon-circle.dontUse: For a repeated in-table/toolbar icon action (use squared-button) or when the icon's meaning isn't obvious (use a labelled button). Note: renders as a 4px rounded square unless you add :rounded=false (finding F7).
icon-circle.example: Topology / chart overlay controls (button-topology-overlay); floating map controls.

insteadOf: an anchor styled as a button

usage.note: Most-used component in the product. byVariant is exact; bySize/modifiers are approximate (shared props).

knownIssues: F1 (high): variant=info/neutral/neutral-light/warning render as the navy primary because buttons.less only allow-lists transparent/error/success/primary-alt/neutral-lighter/neutral-lightest to escape navy (high-specificity :not). `neutral` used 77x yet renders navy.
F2 (low): danger renders a light/ghost style, not solid red; use error for destructive actions.
F3 (high, a11y): focused buttons have outline:none and no focus shadow — no visible focus indicator (WCAG 2.4.7). Add a :focus-visible ring (outline 2px var(--primary)).
F4 (medium, a11y): small (~24px) is below the 44-48px touch target; large (~34px) equals default. Reserve small for dense desktop.
F5 (low): large renders the same height as default (used 9x).
F6 (low): shadow prop is inverted — shadow=true (default) applies .button-shadow which removes box-shadow. Rename to noShadow/flat or invert.

F7 (medium): shape=circle isn't circular — default rounded class (4px) overrides Ant .ant-btn-circle (50%); measured 4px radius. Real product behaviour: of 198 shape=circle buttons only 24 pass :rounded=false (true circle), ~174 render as rounded squares (~88% mislabeled). Pass :rounded=false for a true circle, or make circle shape override radius.
changelog: 2026-06-05: added; variants corrected to distinct set + primary-alt; navy-fallback flagged (F1); light/dark verified.
2026-06-06: enhanced doc standard — anatomy/behaviors/content/accessibility (F3/F4/F5), related, changelog.

2026-06-07: thorough button audit — added icon buttons (shape=circle 218x + squared-button 365x) story + section; findings F6 (inverted shadow) + F7 (circle not circular); noted FlotoLink + segmented-control relatives.

2026-06-30: fixed the `block` (full-width) modifier — the custom-element host defaulted to inline so width:100% had nothing to fill; added :host([block]){display:block;width:100%} (+ the showcase stage now expands for any [block] element). Block buttons now span their container.

2026-07-01: fixed font-weight 500→400 (owner) — the product/Storybook button is Ant's default 400 (@btn-font-weight override is commented out; no LESS sets a weight). Button had never been diff-gated, so the wrong weight was never caught.

2026-07-01: fixed the large size (owner) — it was inheriting the default 0.8rem font. The product large button keeps the DEFAULT height/padding but bumps the font to --font-size-lg (1rem) (@font-size-lg: @text-regular; @btn-font-size-lg: @font-size-lg) — bigger text, same box height. .s-large now sets font-size: var(--font-size-lg, 1rem).

2026-07-01: built specs/button.spec.mjs and diff-gated the button for the first time (13 scenarios, light+dark) — the gate caught the small-button padding (12px→7px, now Ant's 7px) and confirms weight 400 / radius 4px / Poppins / large-1rem. Two intentional divergences declared: ghost (navy vs Ant dark-bg white) and primary-hover (DS token 0.7 vs product render 0.89).

2026-07-01: added the icon+text button example (owner asked) — the product has 83× leading-icon+label buttons (MIcon in the slot) and 538× icon-only (circle/squared). obs-button already supports both via the default slot (.btn is inline-flex gap:6px); showcased both in the Elements gallery. Note: the Storybook button story only shows icon-ONLY.

2026-07-01: replaced the placeholder button-example icons with the REAL product icons (from src/assets/icons/icons.js); also added a dedicated Icons page (542 Font Awesome Light glyphs) with search + copy SVG/PNG + download.

a11y.summary: Native <button>; Enter/Space activate. Icon-only (shape=circle / .squared-button) needs an aria-label. small ≈24px (sub-44 target).
issues: No visible focus ring (SF-001 / WCAG 2.4.7) — :focus-visible planned.
a11y.$note: Catalogue-wide gap SF-001 = no visible :focus-visible ring; tracked in findings/.

slots.default: button label / content (text and/or an icon)
